result.rationale: app/views/embed/loading.html.erb adds `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);` with no condition, no retry cap, and no check that the topic ever materializes. If the enqueued Jobs::RetrieveTopic fails (e.g., TopicRetriever's invalid_host? is true, embed_by_username user is blank, or fetch/Readability raises), the embed/best action keeps rendering 'loading' and the client reloads every 30 seconds indefinitely — an unbounded client/server polling loop with no termination condition introduced by this diff.
